name: CLIENT_ID
label: OAuth Client ID
help: A Scoped OAuth app registered on your own PagerDuty account. Only users of that account can connect, and each sees only what PagerDuty shows them.
setupSteps: Sign in to your PagerDuty account as a Manager, Global Admin or Account Owner, and open Integrations > Developer Tools > App Registration.
Select New App, and leave its App Type as Private. Under Functionality, add OAuth and choose "Scoped OAuth".
Grant it these permissions: Incidents (read and write), Schedules (read and write), and read access to Services, Teams, Users, On-Calls, Priorities and Escalation Policies.
Add the Redirect URL below, and save.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret here.
